{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Replace -1 in customer_age with NaN
data['customer_age'] = data['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)

# Remove rows with revenue = '999,999.99' (QA orders)
data_clean = data[data['revenue'] != '999,999.99']

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
# First, remove commas from revenue
data_clean['revenue'] = data_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
data_clean['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(data_clean['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check the shape after cleaning
print(f"Number of rows after removing QA orders: {len(data_clean)}")

# Check for any remaining invalid revenue values
print(f"Number of invalid revenue values after conversion: {data_clean['revenue'].isna().sum()}")

# Show the first few cleaned revenue values
print("\nFirst few cleaned revenue values:")
print(data_clean['revenue'].head())"}
